title: Behind the Curtain?
can_do: 用位置词提出一个可检查的猜测，并根据新线索继续寻找。
trigger: One toy car is missing during cleanup, and Mom can see a clue near the curtain.
repair_response: No, not under it. Maybe behind it.
setting: Putting toy cars into a basket.
essential_props: toy cars, a basket, and a curtain

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: One toy car is still missing from the basket.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: I looked there. I can see something by the curtain.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Yes, the blue car is behind it.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: There it is. I will put it in the basket.

replay_cards.title: Check the coat pocket
replay_cards.setting: Looking for a mitten by the door
replay_cards.change: The mitten is not in the basket
replay_cards.challenge: Ask whether it is in the coat pocket, check, find it, and complete the pair

replay_cards.title: Check under the book
replay_cards.change: A small red tip is visible near a book
replay_cards.challenge: Ask whether the crayon is under the book, lift it with Mom, and return the crayon

parent_support: Use a visible clue so the second guess follows evidence.
Let the child check the safe location and complete the original cleanup task.
